name: Board Game Atlas API
tagline: Board game search, prices, and Kickstarter data (service shut down).
description: Board Game Atlas provided a modern REST API for searching board games, retrieving prices, Kickstarter campaign data, and game metadata as a complement to BoardGameGeek. The public API at api.boardgameatlas.com and the main product appear to have been shut down; documentation and endpoints no longer serve live product content as of 2025–2026.

auth.details: Client ID (client_id query parameter) obtained from a Board Game Atlas developer account; historically self-serve via the site.

use_cases: search board games by name or filters
get retail price and MSRP for a board game
look up Kickstarter campaign data for games
fetch game metadata (players, playtime, age) for a catalog
